domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number (including atypical forms like a + b/c) into an equivalent improper fraction by combining whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number a b/c as (a·c+b)/c
A step rewrites an atypical mixed form (e.g., 2 3/2) as a sum (2 + 3/2) and then into a single improper fraction
exclusion_criteria: A step only rewrites an integer as an equivalent fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S02 instead)
A step only finds/uses a common denominator and scales fractions (tag S03 instead)
A step only performs subtraction or simplifies the result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Rewrite whole as fraction
skills.definition: Express an integer as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator to enable fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites an integer n as an equivalent fraction with a chosen denominator d (e.g., n = (n·d)/d)
The chosen denominator is selected to match another fraction’s denominator (given or planned) so subtraction can proceed
exclusion_criteria: A step converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (tag S01 instead)
A step finds an LCM/common denominator between two non-integer fractions and scales both (tag S03 instead)
A step performs the subtraction or simplifies the computed result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction with that denominator by scaling numerator and denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step identifies a common denominator/LCM for two fractions with different denominators
A step scales numerator and denominator to convert one or more fractions to the common denominator (e.g., to /12, /18, /24)
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the step proceeds directly to subtraction (tag S04 instead)
A step only rewrites an integer as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S02 instead)
A step only reduces/simplifies after subtraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract and simplify
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are in compatible form (same denominator and/or separated whole and fractional parts) and reduce/format the result to an acceptable simplest form.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators (including cases after common-denominator conversion)
A step subtracts by decomposing mixed numbers into whole and fractional parts (e.g., (3−3)+(4/5−2/5))
A step reduces the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or expresses an equivalent final form (e.g., integer, mixed number), including recognizing outcomes like 0 or 1
exclusion_criteria: A step’s main action is converting mixed numbers to improper fractions (tag S01 instead)
A step’s main action is rewriting an integer as a fraction (tag S02 instead)
A step’s main action is finding/using a common denominator and scaling fractions (tag S03 instead)
